TASK-BDME-001.title: Architecture Baseline Inventory
TASK-BDME-001.description: Inventory current backend architecture, workflow ownership, runtime dependencies, and migration risk map before any code movement.

TASK-BDME-002.title: Secret And Config Safety Baseline
TASK-BDME-002.description: Establish committed-config safety and production fail-fast rules for secrets and internal auth.

TASK-BDME-003.title: HTTP And GRPC Contract Baseline
TASK-BDME-003.description: Capture current public HTTP and gateway-to-backend gRPC behavior before service extraction.

TASK-BDME-004.title: Core Workflow Regression Baseline
TASK-BDME-004.description: Protect auth, recruitment, interview, offer, notification, and AI workflows with focused regression tests.

TASK-BDME-005.title: Harness And Knowledge Impact Baseline
TASK-BDME-005.description: Verify this feature Harness, knowledge impact routing, and reporting conventions before implementation tasks begin.

TASK-BDME-006.title: Observability Baseline Design
TASK-BDME-006.description: Define the telemetry contract for metrics, traces, logs, and cutover diagnostics.

TASK-BDME-007.title: Deployment And Readiness Baseline
TASK-BDME-007.description: Align current deployment, probes, local scripts, and readiness assumptions with the staged migration plan.

TASK-BDME-008.title: Bounded Context Architecture Contract
TASK-BDME-008.description: Create the enforceable bounded-context contract for target domains and workers.

TASK-BDME-009.title: DDD Module Skeleton
TASK-BDME-009.description: Introduce compile-safe bounded-context module skeletons without moving behavior.

TASK-BDME-010.title: Identity Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-010.description: Move auth, users, tokens, RBAC, scopes, and audit logic behind Identity-owned boundaries.

TASK-BDME-011.title: Recruitment Job Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-011.description: Move job and HR recruitment use cases behind Recruitment-owned boundaries.

TASK-BDME-012.title: Recruitment Candidate Resume Application Boundary
TASK-BDME-012.description: Move candidate profile, resume, and application lifecycle ownership into Recruitment.

TASK-BDME-013.title: Interview Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-013.description: Move interview schedules, tasks, feedback, and lifecycle state into Interview boundaries.

TASK-BDME-014.title: Offer Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-014.description: Move offer lifecycle, offer events, and candidate offer decisions into Offer boundaries.

TASK-BDME-015.title: Notification Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-015.description: Move notification persistence, unread counts, email coordination, and realtime delivery behind Notification boundaries.

TASK-BDME-016.title: AI Agent Boundary Modularization
TASK-BDME-016.description: Move chat sessions, agent runs, prompt/skill/memory, embeddings, MCP governance, provider fallback, and AI audit into AI Agent boundaries.

TASK-BDME-017.title: Analytics Projection Boundary
TASK-BDME-017.description: Create the Analytics bounded-context boundary around event-projection read models and reporting APIs.

TASK-BDME-018.title: Boundary Enforcement Checks
TASK-BDME-018.description: Add automated or scripted checks for forbidden cross-domain imports, repository access, and ownership drift.

TASK-BDME-019.title: Domain Event Envelope Contract
TASK-BDME-019.description: Define and implement the standard domain-event envelope shared by Outbox, Inbox, consumers, and Analytics projections.

TASK-BDME-020.title: Outbox Standardization
TASK-BDME-020.description: Standardize Outbox writes, publish states, retry metadata, retention, and observability.

TASK-BDME-021.title: Inbox Idempotency Foundation
TASK-BDME-021.description: Introduce Inbox or equivalent idempotency controls for event consumers.

TASK-BDME-022.title: Notification Event Conversion
TASK-BDME-022.description: Convert notification-producing cross-domain writes to domain events and idempotent Notification consumers.

TASK-BDME-023.title: Interview Offer Recruitment Event Decoupling
TASK-BDME-023.description: Replace hidden cross-domain state writes among Recruitment, Interview, and Offer with events, adapters, or process-manager logic.
notes: Dependencies: TASK-BDME-011, TASK-BDME-012, TASK-BDME-013, TASK-BDME-014, TASK-BDME-019, TASK-BDME-020, TASK-BDME-021

TASK-BDME-024.title: Analytics Projection Event Ingestion
TASK-BDME-024.description: Build Analytics ingestion directly on domain-event projections/read models.

TASK-BDME-025.title: Event Replay And Dead Letter Runbooks
TASK-BDME-025.description: Document and script safe replay, repair, dead-letter inspection, and retention workflows.

TASK-BDME-026.title: Service Binary And Deployment Convention
TASK-BDME-026.description: Establish the convention for independently deployable service binaries inside the monorepo.

TASK-BDME-027.title: Notification Service Skeleton
TASK-BDME-027.description: Create a compile-safe Notification service binary skeleton without production traffic cutover.

TASK-BDME-028.title: Notification Service Runtime Extraction
TASK-BDME-028.description: Run Notification persistence, unread counts, email coordination, realtime delivery, and consumers from the Notification service runtime.

TASK-BDME-029.title: Notification Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-029.description: Route gateway notification APIs and realtime delivery to the extracted Notification service with rollback controls.

TASK-BDME-030.title: AI Agent Service Skeleton
TASK-BDME-030.description: Create a compile-safe AI Agent service binary skeleton without production traffic cutover.

TASK-BDME-031.title: AI Agent Runtime Extraction
TASK-BDME-031.description: Move AI chat, agent runs, provider fallback, and async AI workload execution into AI Agent service runtime.

TASK-BDME-032.title: AI Agent Knowledge Runtime Extraction
TASK-BDME-032.description: Extract AI prompt, skill, memory, embedding, MCP governance, and AI-derived intelligence ownership into AI Agent runtime boundaries.

TASK-BDME-033.title: AI Agent Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-033.description: Route gateway AI endpoints to the extracted AI Agent service with controlled rollout and rollback evidence.

TASK-BDME-034.title: Identity Service Skeleton
TASK-BDME-034.description: Create a compile-safe Identity service binary skeleton without production auth traffic cutover.

TASK-BDME-035.title: Identity Auth RBAC API Extraction
TASK-BDME-035.description: Extract Identity auth, token invalidation, RBAC, scopes, and audit APIs into Identity service runtime.

TASK-BDME-036.title: Identity Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-036.description: Route gateway authentication and authorization integration to Identity service with rollback controls.

TASK-BDME-037.title: Recruitment Service Skeleton
TASK-BDME-037.description: Create a compile-safe Recruitment service binary skeleton without production recruitment traffic cutover.

TASK-BDME-038.title: Recruitment Service API Extraction
TASK-BDME-038.description: Extract Recruitment jobs, candidate recruitment profile, resumes, applications, and lifecycle APIs into Recruitment service runtime.

TASK-BDME-039.title: Recruitment Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-039.description: Route gateway recruitment APIs to Recruitment service with controlled rollout and rollback evidence.

TASK-BDME-040.title: Interview Service Skeleton And API Extraction
TASK-BDME-040.description: Create and extract Interview service runtime for schedules, interviewer tasks, feedback, and lifecycle APIs.

TASK-BDME-041.title: Interview Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-041.description: Route gateway interview APIs to Interview service with controlled rollout and rollback evidence.

TASK-BDME-042.title: Offer Service Skeleton And API Extraction
TASK-BDME-042.description: Create and extract Offer service runtime for offer lifecycle, offer events, and candidate offer decisions.

TASK-BDME-043.title: Offer Gateway Cutover
TASK-BDME-043.description: Route gateway offer APIs to Offer service with controlled rollout and rollback evidence.

TASK-BDME-044.title: Analytics Service Extraction
TASK-BDME-044.description: Extract Analytics service runtime backed directly by event projections/read models, not transitional transactional service read APIs.

TASK-BDME-045.title: Worker Service Decomposition
TASK-BDME-045.description: Separate async worker workloads from request-serving workloads with independently scalable worker service binaries.

TASK-BDME-046.title: Table Ownership Manifest
TASK-BDME-046.description: Create and enforce a table ownership manifest for every existing table and target service context.

TASK-BDME-047.title: Schema Separation Plan
TASK-BDME-047.description: Prepare schema or physical database separation after service boundaries and table ownership are proven.

TASK-BDME-048.title: Internal Service Security Hardening
TASK-BDME-048.description: Harden service-to-service authentication and transport with internal TLS plus required GRPC_INTERNAL_TOKEN.

TASK-BDME-049.title: Metrics And Tracing Implementation
TASK-BDME-049.description: Implement Prometheus-compatible metrics, OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing, and structured log propagation.

TASK-BDME-050.title: Readiness Worker Health And Dependency Degradation
TASK-BDME-050.description: Implement true liveness/readiness and dependency degradation behavior for services and workers.

TASK-BDME-051.title: Load Test Harness And Initial Targets
TASK-BDME-051.description: Create and run load-test evidence for the confirmed initial concurrency, latency, and async AI targets.

TASK-BDME-052.title: Final Readiness Cleanup And Architecture Review
TASK-BDME-052.description: Complete final architecture readiness review and remove or formally approve remaining transitional adapters, direct access, and operational gaps.
